Date: 2026-10-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: GCP co-sell coverage roster & opportunity staging for Vektor Cloud

Team / Sam - kicking off a short thread to align coverage for the next co-sell sprint with Vektor Cloud. Goal: finalize who owns which opps for handoff to GCP PMs and confirm a staging order for the three high-priority deals.

Agenda / asks:
- Vanessa / Karthik: please confirm primary/backup PM coverage for each opportunity in the attached roster (gcp_cosell_roster_v1.xlsx).
- Naomi: can you validate which deals are marketplace-ready vs require listing prep? Mark in the sheet.
- Sergio: flag any quota/discount asks; we'll escalate if needed.
- Sam / Elena (Vektor): confirm the updated close dates and whether you want GCP to be looped in for technical validation on Deal A + B.

Preliminary notes in the sheet: Deal A (HS:5647382) looks close — customer legal already on LOA, needs GCP to validate marketplace billing flow. Deal B has technical gating (service account provisioning). Deal C is long lead (Q1).

Attachments: gcp_cosell_roster_v1.xlsx (roster + opp staging tab).

If we can get confirmations by Friday EOD (10/02), I'll schedule a 30-min triage with GCP and Sam for Monday.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Principal Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@vektorcloud.com>

Subject: Re: GCP co-sell coverage roster & opportunity staging for Vektor Cloud

Alex — thanks for pulling this together. Quick updates inline and attached a short notes PDF (opportunity_notes_VEK.pdf) with two items that need PM attention:

- Coverage: I assigned primary/backup in the roster: Karthik -> Deal A (primary), Priya -> Deal B (primary), Naomi -> Deal C (primary). I added backups for holidays.
- Marketplace readiness: Naomi marked Deal A as "listing prep required" and added the lead artifact list.
- Escalation: Deal A is requesting a billing flow test from GCP (customer request). I've put the HubSpot links in the notes.

Sam — can you confirm whether Vektor will sign the updated LOA once GCP validates billing? Also, do you have a preferred time window for next week for the triage?

Attachments: opportunity_notes_VEK.pdf (2 pages), updated roster tab in gcp_cosell_roster_v1.xlsx.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: GCP co-sell coverage roster & opportunity staging for Vektor Cloud

Thanks — roster looks great, appreciate the quick turn. A couple notes from Vektor: 

1) Billing validation: we can provide a sandbox customer account for the GCP billing flow test. Prefer to run that during PHT window Tue-Wed next week (10/06-10/07).
2) Regional coverage: Vektor has EMEA legal sign-off coming through; can we loop an EMEA PM for Deal C? If so, I can intro them (Elena is on CC).
3) LOA: we'll hold on signing until GCP confirms billing flow; should be quick once validated.

Also attached is an export of our pipeline for the three opps (vektor_pipeline_export.csv) so you have the latest commit dates.

Sam
Sam Lee
Head of Strategic Accounts, Vektor Cloud

2) Naomi: start listing prep checklist for Deal A; capture the missing artifacts by EOD Friday.
